_noise.definition: S_sigma = S_train + sigma * rms * Z with Z ~ N(0,1) i.i.d. (fixed seed), rms = ||S_train - mu||_F / sqrt(d_full n); err_clean = ||S_train - G(E(S_sigma))|| / ||S_train - mu||, err_noisy = ||S_sigma - G(E(S_sigma))|| / ||S_sigma - mu|| with the expected off-state-space noise energy added to both norms
